product.olivetti-m400-60.summary: The M400 variant with a 486DX2 and ATI 8514 Ultra support.
product.olivetti-m400-60.history: The Olivetti service guide documents M400-60 (the M400 variant with a 486DX2 and ATI 8514 Ultra support).
product.olivetti-m400-60.architecture: The board determines which peripheral combination needs verification. The guide identifies BA334 · 82C452A · IDE.
product.olivetti-m400-60.firmware: The BIOS revision helps identify the service configuration. The guide records Flash · 2.08.
product.olivetti-m400-60.verified: The identity was checked in Olivetti documentation. The sheet remains under research.
product.olivetti-m400-60.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
